column1: # The word table (decision agenda 4.7; docs/preprocessing_phase.md, step 1), approved by the author 2026-11-17.
# lemma<TAB>pos<TAB>match<TAB>held_out. pos: the Universal POS tags whose uses are in scope, joined by |;
# each noun accepts PROPN (names are left to entity recognition), and learning, embedding (VERB) and
# embodiment, transformer, cloud (ADJ) accept the tags the small tagger gives their noun uses
# (scripts/evidence/word_table_draft.py); component, feedback and five held-out words (ADJ) accept the
# adjective tag the transformer gives their noun modifiers (the usages audit, docs/usages_audit.md,
# approved by the author 2026-11-20), and information processing (VERB) the verb tag it gives the
# phrase's -ing head (the audit's redraw, approved by the author 2026-11-21). match: lemma (the lemma
# or the form), or form only (having).
# held_out: the confirming run's words (6.2), drafted before step 6; none yet.
# Held-out words (agenda 6.2; docs/held_out.md), approved by the author 2026-11-19, are marked yes in
# held_out: sealed until the confirmation plan, never printed by development outputs, only hashed.
